court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. C. Ramar for R1 Additional Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, for the issuance of Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to consider petitioner's representation, dated 10.03.2015 to issue No Objection Certificate to petitioner's lands which is situated in Survey No. 191 to an extent of 73 cents at Allinagaram Revenue Village, Theni Taluk, Theni District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.S. Sundar, J.:— When the writ petition was posted on 02.12.2019, there was no representation for the petitioner. Hence, this Court directed the Registry to post the matter today (i.e., 03.12.2019) under the caption ‘for dismissal’. Though the matter is posted today under the caption ‘for dismissal’, there is no representation for the petitioner.

2. Hence, this writ petition is dismissed for non prosecution. No costs.
